Error: timed out waiting for response

(classify.bats / supervisor.bats fixture: agy's SIGNATURE soft response-timeout. The headless
wrapper prints "timed out waiting for response" and exits 143 AFTER agy may have already committed a
unit. It MUST classify as `timeout` — so the supervisor advances the iteration and ratchets any
committed candidate — NOT `transient_crash`, which would `continue` the SAME iteration forever and
wedge the loop at iter 0 (the never-progress bug this fixture guards against). §7.4.)
